Definition: from G4012 and G3624; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically as a noun):--neighbour.
BiblicalUsage: Perioikos means a neighbour, one housed around. Elizabeth's neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shown great mercy upon her, and they rejoiced with her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mercy is meant to be shared with the neighbours: they heard, and they rejoiced with her.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of John the Baptist
